sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations
Deterministic canonical bytes, renderer, and lifecycle

repo_truth: Definition/profile, canonical Charter, intake evaluator, lifecycle state machine, runtime-vector validator, native Windows strict reads, and authenticator/approver security core are present in the shared worktree with focused suites green. This lane owns append-only storage plus transaction/recovery/promotion integration only.
allowed_scope: Add narrowly factored engine modules for trusted append-only content-addressed lineage storage, authority locks, journal intents/commit markers/recovery, approval records, promotion, and lifecycle commit integration.
Add focused engine tests named hcm_2_2_*transaction*.rs, hcm_2_2_*promotion*.rs, or hcm_2_2_*lineage_store*.rs and use frozen packet vectors directly.

Coordinate only additive module declarations/reexports in crates/engine/src/lib.rs with the parent. Do not edit parent-owned Charter/intake/lifecycle/authenticator modules without an explicit parent continuation.
Use RED tests first and run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\codex-build\handbook-hcm22 and TEMP/TMP=D:\codex-temp\handbook-hcm22.
Run GitNexus impact before every existing function/class/method edit; report and pause before HIGH or CRITICAL edits.
non_goals: Do not edit definitions, schemas, profiles, compiler, flow, CLI, skills, setup, doctor, proof/control, planning, handoff, ledger, or other dispatch files.
Do not weaken native Windows refusal/identity guarantees, add a fallback lock/write path, delete final content-addressed records, or implement HCM-2.3.
Do not commit or create handoffs, ledger rows, dispatches, or user-visible task hops.
tasks: Read the complete dispatch, exact authority sections and vectors, live parent modules, and platform boundaries.

Write RED tests for create-new-or-equal append-only records, safe refs/bounds, create-null versus mandatory amendment basis equality, recovery-before-intent, raw 72-byte commit markers, total observed-state recovery, partial installs, ABA/substitution, concurrency, and no visible partial authority.
Implement the smallest fail-closed service that persists exact intake/candidate/approval/promotion/lifecycle records and makes promotion the sole canonical Charter write authority.
Return exact implemented versus remaining protocol coverage, changed files, RED/GREEN evidence, GitNexus impacts, and parent integration requirements.
contracts_and_gates: No mutating operation proceeds without a safe native platform path; unsupported paths refuse before directories, locks, intents, semantic records, or platform calls.
Canonical truth, promotion record, and lifecycle transition become authority-visible through one journal commit point under promotion-then-registry-then-lifecycle lock order.
Every downstream basis, retained registry pair, declared fingerprint, content-addressed ref basename, and staged byte fingerprint is equal and revalidated at promotion/recovery.
Final content-addressed records are never deleted during rollback; preexisting equal bytes are reusable and unequal bytes refuse.
stop_conditions: Stop before any HIGH or CRITICAL existing-symbol edit and return the blast radius to the parent.
Return blocked if one durable authority-visibility commit cannot be provided on native Windows without a weaker fallback.
Return blocked if the required record protocol conflicts with frozen vectors or requires HCM-2.3.
